candidate.definition_en: To thrust a knife or other pointed weapon into someone or something.
candidate.explanation_ar: يضرب حد بسكينة أو آلة حادة.

senses.definition_en: To thrust a knife or other pointed weapon into someone or something.
senses.definition_ar: يطعن شخصاً أو شيئاً بسكين أو بأداة حادة.
examples: The suspect attempted to stab the officer with a broken bottle.
Don't stab the meat with your fork.
He would never stab his partner in the back for personal gain.
